## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M10 - Code Auto-completion.

## Technical Scope

- Evaluated with Villanova-2B-2512-Preview under controlled inference parameters
- Average response time around half a second in reported tests
- Strength on simple algorithmic tasks and limitations on complex context-heavy completions
- Max context length in current setup: 4096 tokens
- Designed for developer assistance and experimentation scenarios

## Run Guidance

Use OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint configured for Villanova-2B deployment

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
